units: <cite ref="Chagigah 6a:16">Ḥag. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ … עוֹלַת תמיד הואי</he> the burnt-offering which the Israelites brought in the desert (<cite ref="Exodus 24:5">Ex. XXIV, 5</cite>) was the daily offering; <he>עולת ראייה הואי</he> was the Temple visitors’ offering; <cite ref="Yevamot 5b:11">Yeb. 5ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:4">Ib. V, 4</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>עוֹלוֹת</he>. Ḥag. l. c. <he>שריבה … יותר מבע׳</he> for the Biblical text ordains, in connection with the princes, more peace-offerings than burnt-offerings. Ib. I, 3; 5; a. fr.
